name: Berries
description: Berries is an AI-powered therapy scribe that generates clinical notes from session recordings in 45 seconds. The platform offers a generous free tier—20 sessions at signup, then 10 sessions/month indefinitely—making it accessible for low-volume practitioners or those testing AI documentation. Trusted by 10,000+ clinicians with HIPAA + PHIPA compliance and SOC 2 certification. At $79/month Pro pricing, Berries sits mid-market between cheaper options (AutoNotes $24/mo) and premium competitors (Mentalyc $70/mo, Upheal $69/mo). Recordings are not stored after note generation, providing strong privacy guarantees.

faqs.q: How much does Berries cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Berries offers a free tier with 20 sessions at signup and 10 sessions/month indefinitely (no credit card required). Pro costs $79/month ($948/year) for unlimited sessions, AI notes, treatment plans, ICD-10 coding, and letters.

faqs.q: Is Berries free tier really unlimited?
faqs.a: The free tier provides 10 sessions per month forever with no time limit. For a therapist with 8-10 clients seen weekly, the free tier covers a meaningful portion of documentation needs. No credit card required to start.

faqs.q: Does Berries store my session recordings?
faqs.a: No. Berries explicitly does not store session recordings after note generation. PHI is excluded from AI model training. This provides strong privacy guarantees beyond basic HIPAA compliance.

faqs.q: Berries vs Mentalyc vs Upheal: which is best?
faqs.a: Choose Berries for the free tier (10 sessions/month) or if privacy (no recording storage) is paramount. Choose Mentalyc for modality-aware notes and Alliance Genie. Choose Upheal for session analytics and pay-per-session pricing. All three are therapy-specific and HIPAA compliant.

Yes. Berries is HIPAA and PHIPA (Canadian) compliant with a signed BAA. The platform is SOC 2 certified. Session recordings are not retained after processing and PHI is excluded from AI training data.
